representative_works: 《孟子》七篇（梁惠王上/下、公孙丑上/下、滕文公上/下、离娄上/下、万章上/下、告子上/下、尽心上/下）
historical_significance: 战国时期儒家学派最重要的代表人物，被后世尊为'亚圣'。首次系统论证人性本善并建立四端说，将孔子道德实践提升为完整的政治哲学体系（民本贵君、仁政王道），创造'浩然之气'这一超越性道德人格概念。其思想构成宋明理学、朝鲜性理学、日本朱子学的核心源头，也是法国启蒙运动时期欧洲思想家了解中国思想的重要窗口。
famous_quote: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻
influence: 孟子思想在汉代开始受到重视，宋代程朱理学尊为'亚圣'，《孟子》升格为四书之一成为科举标准教材长达六百年。其性善论、民本思想、浩然之气理论深刻影响宋明理学（程颢、程颐、朱熹、陆九渊、王阳明）、朝鲜性理学（李滉、李珥）、日本朱子学（朱舜水、林罗山）。近代梁启超、熊十力、牟宗三重新诠释孟子，联系民主、人权与现代性。其'民贵君轻'思想比西方社会契约论早两千余年，被当代新儒家视为中国最早的民主政治哲学萌芽。

modes.name_en: Goodness of Human Nature Theory (Four Beginnings)
modes.definition_zh: 以'孺子入井'思想实验论证人性本善，提出恻隐、羞恶、辞让、是非'四端'为道德能力的先天依据。性善非指人性完美，而是人具有向善潜能与道德萌芽（端），如同水之就下。通过'扩而充之'的修养工夫，将四端发展为仁义礼智四德。性善论是一切道德修养与政治治理的形上根基，为儒家道德形上学奠基。
modes.definition_en: Using the 'child about to fall into a well' thought experiment to argue that human nature is inherently good, proposing the 'Four Beginnings' (恻隐/compassion, 羞恶/shame, 辞让/respect, 是非/right-wrong) as the innate basis of moral capacity. Goodness of nature does not mean humans are perfect, but that they possess the potential and sprouts (端) for moral improvement, like water flowing downward. Through cultivation practices of 'expanding and enriching' (扩而充之), these Four Beginnings develop into the four virtues of benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom. This theory forms the metaphysical foundation of all moral cultivation and political governance.
key_concepts: 四端（恻隐/羞恶/辞让/是非）
process: 识别情境中的道德直觉反应（怵惕恻隐）
确认四端为仁义礼智的萌芽与先天依据
通过修养工夫'扩而充之'
将道德潜能发展为完善的四德
modern_applications: 道德教育与品格培养
积极心理学中的优势识别
儿童早期道德发展评估
领导力中的同理心训练

modes.definition_zh: '民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻'——将性善论推演为政治哲学，以'不忍人之心，行不忍人之政'确立仁政王道。政治合法性根基在于民众福祉而非君权神授。通过'制民之产、谨庠序之教、省刑罚薄税敛'等具体措施，构建中国古代最激进的政治平等主义宣言。'得乎丘民为天子'确立民众授权的政治合法性原则，比西方社会契约论早两千余年。
modes.definition_en: 'The people are paramount, the state comes next, the ruler is least' — extending the theory of good human nature into political philosophy, establishing benevolent governance through 'the heart that cannot bear to see suffering'. Political legitimacy is rooted in the welfare of the people, not divine right. Through concrete measures including 'securing livelihoods, establishing schools, reducing punishments and taxes', it constructs the most radical political egalitarian manifesto in ancient China. 'Those who win the hearts of the common people become Son of Heaven' establishes a popular authorization principle of political legitimacy, predating Western social contract theory by over two millennia.
process: 评估政策/决策对民众基本生存的影响
优先保障'制民之产'（恒产）
建立教化体系（谨庠序之教）
以民众福祉为政治合法性判准
modern_applications: 公共政策评估与民众影响分析
社会治理与公共服务优先级设定
企业社会责任（CSR）框架
民主治理中的民意代表性

modes.definition_zh: '我善养吾浩然之气。其为气也，至大至刚，以直养而无害，则塞于天地之间。'通过'集义所生'的方式培养至大至刚的道德人格力量，以持志统摄精气，实现儒家内向超越的核心实践路径。养气非气功或神秘主义，乃长期道德实践所形成的人格力量与精神气质。'其为气也，配义与道；无是，馁也'——此气必须与义和道配合才能充盈。
modes.definition_en: 'I am good at cultivating my noble qi. This qi is the greatest and most robust; when nurtured with uprightness and unharmed, it fills heaven and earth. Through 'accumulating righteousness', one cultivates the most powerful moral personality force, using firm will to direct vital energy — the core practice path of Confucian inner transcendence. This qi cultivation is not qigong or mysticism, but the spiritual force and temperament formed through long-term moral practice. 'This qi must be paired with righteousness and the Dao; without it, it starves' — this energy requires alignment with justice and truth to flourish.
process: 确立坚定的道德志向（持其志）
在日常实践中持续积累义行（集义）
以直养而无害，不强制不助长
察觉人格力量生长征象（塞于天地）
modern_applications: 领导力中的道德勇气培养
压力管理与精神韧性建设
组织文化中的价值观践行
个人品格与职业声誉的长期建设

modes.definition_zh: '王何必曰利？亦有仁义而已矣。''鱼，我所欲也；熊掌，亦我所欲也。二者不可得兼，舍鱼而取熊掌者也。'严格区分道义价值与功利计算，主张先义后利。当义利冲突时选择义而非利，'舍生取义'确立道德优先的价值框架。在政治决策中反对以利益为出发点（'何必曰利'），个人修养中以'所欲有甚于生者'确立道德价值的绝对优先性。',
modes.definition_en: 'Why should Your Majesty speak of profit? There is only benevolence and righteousness.' 'Fish is what I desire; bear's paw is also what I desire. If both cannot be obtained, I舍弃 fish for bear's paw.' Strictly distinguishing moral value from utilitarian calculation, advocating righteousness before profit. When conflicting, choose righteousness over profit — 'sacrificing life for righteousness' establishes the absolute priority of moral values. In political decisions, opposing profit-oriented starting points; in personal cultivation, 'what I desire is more than life itself' establishes the absolute priority of moral values.
process: 识别情境中的义利结构
区分短期利益与长期道义
在冲突时坚持义优先于利
'舍生取义'：在最极端情境中坚守道德底线
modern_applications: 商业伦理决策框架
政策制定的利益-价值权衡
职业道德困境处理
危机时刻的价值优先级判断

modes.name_en: Knowing Persons through Their Times Method
modes.definition_zh: '颂其诗，读其书，不知其人可乎？是以论其世也。'提出了解作者生平与时代背景来理解其学说的历史语境化解读方法。不脱离历史条件抽象评价人物，而是在特定时空中理解其思想与行为。这一方法为后世'考据学''知人论世'治学方法奠基，是古代中国最早的系统性历史理解方法论。
modes.definition_en: 'Praise their poetry, read their writings — is it acceptable not to know the person? Therefore one discusses their era.' Proposing a contextualized interpretive method that understands an author's学说 through biography and historical background. Not evaluating figures abstractly detached from their historical conditions, but understanding their thoughts and behaviors within specific时空. This method laid the foundation for later 'evidential scholarship' (考据学) and 'knowing persons through their times', representing the earliest systematic historical hermeneutics in ancient China.
process: 了解对象（作者/人物）的生平经历
研究其所处的时代背景与历史条件
在特定时空中理解其思想与行为逻辑
避免脱离历史条件的抽象评价
modern_applications: 学术研究中的历史语境分析
跨文化理解与比较研究
人物传记研究与口述历史
组织管理中的情境领导力

modes.definition_zh: '行有不得者，皆反求诸己，其身正而天下归之。'当行为未达预期效果时不怨天尤人，从自身找原因并通过自我修正实现改进。内省工夫是儒家修养的根本路径，'正己而后正人'是其核心原则。通过不断的自我检视与修正，实现个人成长到组织管理的通用方法论。
modes.definition_en: 'When actions do not achieve desired results, always turn inward and examine oneself; when one's own character is upright, all under heaven returns.' When behavior fails to achieve expected results, do not blame Heaven or others — find the cause within oneself and improve through self-correction. Introspection is the fundamental path of Confucian cultivation, with 'rectifying oneself before rectifying others' as its core principle. Through continuous self-examination and correction, it provides a universal methodology from personal growth to organizational management.
process: 遭遇挫败时暂停外部归因
逐项检视自身行为与动机
找出可改进的具体方面
制定修正计划并实践
modern_applications: 个人成长与自我提升
团队管理中的领导者自省
质量管理中的根因分析
冲突解决中的自我反思

modes.name_en: Heart-Mind Cultivation through Reducing Desires Method
modes.definition_zh: '养心莫善于寡欲。'通过减少物欲来保存天赋善性，实现心性修养的根本途径。'存其心，养其性，所以事天也。'寡欲非禁欲，乃护持良知良能之本真。过多的物欲会遮蔽四端萌芽，使本心放失；减少欲望则是保存和扩充善性的最有效方法。这与佛家'断欲求解脱'不同，孟子之目的是保存善良本性而非追求解脱。
modes.definition_en: 'The best way to cultivate the mind is through reducing desires.' Preserving innate good nature by minimizing material desires — this is the fundamental path of heart-mind cultivation. 'Preserving the mind and nurturing nature is how one serves Heaven.' Reducing desires does not mean asceticism, but protecting the authenticity of innate conscience and capacity. Excessive material desires obscure the Four Beginnings sprouts, causing the original mind to be lost; reducing desires is the most effective method to preserve and expand good nature. Unlike Buddhism's 'cutting desires to achieve liberation', Mencius' goal is preserving善良本性 rather than pursuing transcendence.
process: 识别当前欲望对心性的遮蔽程度
减少不必要的物质追求和消耗
保存天赋善性不受物欲侵蚀
通过'存心养性'实现事天境界
modern_applications: 极简主义生活方式实践
消费主义批判与反思
心理健康中的欲望管理
可持续发展与伦理消费

modes.name_en: Extending Kindness to Others Method (Tui En)
modes.definition_zh: '老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼。''推恩足以保四海。'从亲亲之情出发，层层外推至仁民、爱物。差等之爱非冷漠，乃伦理扩展的现实起点。齐宣王'以羊易牛'案例展示推恩操作：从微观心理（不忍牛）推演至宏观政治（仁政王道），展示'推恩及人'作为连接内心道德与外王政治的关键枢纽。既符合人情常理又具普遍主义指向，为现代'同理心训练''全球伦理'提供东方范式。
modes.definition_en: 'Respect your own elders, and extend that respect to others' elders; care for your own children, and extend that care to others' children.' 'Extending kindness is sufficient to protect all under heaven.' Starting from familial love, progressively extending outward to benevolence toward people and care for all things. Graded love is not indifference, but the realistic starting point of ethical extension. The case of King Xuan of Qi 'replacing an ox with a lamb' demonstrates the Tui En operation: from micro-psychology (compassion for the ox) to macro-politics (benevolent governance), showing 'extending kindness' as the key bridge connecting inner morality to outer political achievement.
process: 确认当下真实的情感体验（如不忍之心）
进行类比思考：将此情感扩展至相似对象
由近及远层层推广（家人→他人→社会）
实现伦理的普遍化扩展
modern_applications: 同理心训练与跨文化理解
企业利益相关者关怀扩展
全球伦理与国际人道主义行动
社区建设与邻里关系

modes.definition_zh: '执中无权，犹执一也。所恶执一者，为其贼道也，举一而废百也。'在坚持基本原则（经）的前提下承认特殊情境的灵活变通（权）。'男女授受不亲，礼也；嫂溺援之以手者，权也。'经权统一，非背离原则而是对原则的真正贯彻。死守常规'执一'反成'贼道'，真正的中庸需要在原则坚守与情境灵活之间找到平衡。
modes.definition_en: 'Holding the mean without flexibility is like holding just one thing. What we detest about rigid adherence is that it harms the Dao — grasping one aspect while discarding a hundred.' Acknowledging flexible adaptation (权) in special circumstances while maintaining basic principles (经). 'Men and women should not hand things directly to each other — this is ritual; but if a sister-in-law is drowning, one should help her by hand — this is flexibility.' Unity of principle and flexibility: not deviating from principles but truly fulfilling them. Rigidly sticking to conventions becomes 'harming the Dao'; true中庸 requires balance between principle adherence and situational flexibility.
process: 确立不可动摇的基本原则（经）
识别特殊情境中的非常规需求
在坚持原则框架下进行灵活变通（权）
确保灵活性不背离原则的核心精神
modern_applications: 复杂决策中的原则-情境平衡
危机管理中的灵活应对策略
制度设计与例外条款处理
领导力判断与情境领导

modes.name_en: Distinguishing Heavenly and Earthly Nobility Method
modes.definition_zh: '天爵：仁、义、忠、信、乐善不倦；人爵：公、卿、大夫。''尽其心者，知其性也；知其性，则知天矣。'区分'天之良贵'（天赋道德尊严）与世俗权力地位（人爵），确立内在价值的优先性。真正的贵不在官位，而在道德人格完满。'修其天爵，而人爵从之'——修养内在道德尊严后，外在世俗地位自然随之而来。确立士人精神的形上依据：'士不可不弘毅，任重而道远'。
modes.definition_en: 'Heavenly nobility: benevolence, righteousness, loyalty, trustworthiness, and tireless commitment to goodness; earthly nobility: dukes, ministers, high officials.' 'Those who fully develop their mind know their nature; those who know their nature know Heaven.' Distinguishing 'Heaven's true worth' (innate moral dignity) from worldly power and status (earthly nobility), establishing the priority of inner value. True nobility lies not in official positions but in complete moral personality. 'Cultivating heavenly nobility, earthly nobility follows' — after cultivating inner moral dignity, worldly status naturally follows. Establishing the metaphysical basis for scholar-official spirit: 'A scholar cannot be without breadth of mind and resolute will; the burden is heavy and the journey long.'
process: 区分内在道德尊严（天爵）与外在世俗地位（人爵）
确认内在价值的优先性和根本性
通过'修其天爵'积累道德人格力量
'尽其心、知其性、知天'：从内心修养通达天道
modern_applications: 职业伦理中的内在价值与外在回报平衡
学术研究的纯学术追求与应用价值的统一
社会评价体系的多元反思
个人成长中的意义感与幸福感

meta.methodology: 文献分析法、概念重构法、思想史溯源、对比研究法
